newsitem.title: UK: LIMIT takes out option on FT-SE 350.
newsitem.headline: LIMIT takes out option on FT-SE 350.

text.p: The London Insurance Market Investment Trust said on Tuesday it has taken out option protection on its FT-SE 350 equity portfolio, by way of a zero cost option "collar".

This protects the equity portfolio, which has a current market value of around 338 million stg, against a fall in the FT-SE 100 index of more than 12.5 per cent below the level of 4357, on the option maturity date of 29 August 1997.

If the FT-SE 100 index rises to more than eight per cent above 4357 on 29 August 1997, LIMIT will be required to pay to the option holder any gain in value above this level, said LIMIT in a statement.

Assuming no change in Lloyd's solvency ratios or in LIMIT's gearing, the effect of the option will be to enable LIMIT's corporate members to maintain their total underwriting capacity at Lloyd's for the 1998 underwriting year at no lower than 3.6 per cent below the current 1997 level of 648 million.
